title: Config: a project
description: <root>/projects/<project>.toml (1.1, 1.4): the project's members and its view of each, and the choices it makes.

owner_id.description: The page user id whose decisions count (10.5).

recently_closed_days.description: How many days the page's Recently closed list looks back (5.8); 7 when unset.

sync_task.description: The id of the app's scheduled task that runs this project's sync job; sync-now prints it so the calling session can run the task now (7.2).

time_limits_days.description: Idle time allowed per priority before a breach (2.3).

routing.description: Overrides of the default routing table (7.4), by launch kind. Triage defaults to claude-opus-5-5 at medium and stronger_look to claude-fable-5-1 at high (triage spec 5.3); a changed routing is a new backend.

demand_threshold.description: Distinct outside people whose demand raises an issue's reach one step (6.2). Default 3.

gate_minutes_per_point.description: Wall-clock minutes per job-size point, the unit shared by effort and gate cost (6.3). Default 15.

closure_recheck_days.description: How many days a closure answer (likely_fixed, duplicate, obsolete) holds before triage asks it again (triage spec 2.2); 14 when unset.

max_triage_items.description: The most items one triage launch names (triage spec 2.2); 40 when unset.

stronger_look_below.description: A priority, type, duplicate or likely_fixed answer whose calibrated top probability is below this needs a stronger look (triage spec 2.5); 0.6 when unset.

eval_history_days.description: How many days eval refresh-history reads back (triage spec 3.2); 730 when unset.

eval_tuning.description: The most tuning items a replay evaluation asks about (triage spec 3.2); 120 when unset.

eval_sample.description: The most held-out items a replay evaluation asks about (triage spec 3.4); 120 when unset.

eval_exclude.description: Truth provenances every evaluation drops by default (triage spec 3.5): filed, github_later, owner_accept, owner_edit or bulk_review:<name>.
